concept.description: Resolves ViewObject entity usages and derives mapped database tables.
concept.cypher: MATCH (usage:Bc4jEntityUsage) WHERE usage.entityFqn IS NOT NULL MATCH (entity:Bc4jEntity) WHERE entity.qualifiedName = usage.entityFqn MERGE (usage)-[:REFERENCES_ENTITY]->(entity) WITH DISTINCT usage MATCH (viewObject:Bc4jViewObject)-[:HAS_ENTITY_USAGE]->(usage) WITH DISTINCT viewObject MATCH (viewObject)-[:HAS_ENTITY_USAGE]->(allUsage:Bc4jEntityUsage) OPTIONAL MATCH (allUsage)-[:REFERENCES_ENTITY]->(mappedEntity:Bc4jEntity) WITH viewObject, count(DISTINCT allUsage) AS usageCount, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mappedEntity IS NOT NULL THEN allUsage END) AS resolvedCount, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mappedEntity.tableName IS NOT NULL THEN allUsage END) AS mappedCount, collect(DISTINCT mappedEntity.tableName) AS tableNames SET viewObject.tableNames = CASE WHEN size(tableNames) > 0 THEN tableNames ELSE null END, viewObject.tableNamesComplete = (usageCount = resolvedCount AND usageCount = mappedCount), viewObject.tableName = CASE WHEN size(tableNames) = 1 AND usageCount = resolvedCount AND usageCount = mappedCount THEN tableNames[0] ELSE null END RETURN viewObject

concept.description: Resolves view-link endpoints to their source and target ViewObjects.
concept.cypher: MATCH (:Bc4jViewLink)-[:HAS_END]->(end:Bc4jViewLinkEnd) MATCH (viewObject:Bc4jViewObject) WHERE viewObject.qualifiedName = end.ownerViewObjectFqn MERGE (end)-[:REFERENCES_VIEW_OBJECT]->(viewObject) RETURN end

concept.description: Resolves application-module view usages to ViewObjects.
concept.cypher: MATCH (usage:Bc4jViewUsage) MATCH (viewObject:Bc4jViewObject) WHERE viewObject.qualifiedName = usage.viewObjectFqn MERGE (usage)-[:USES_VIEW_OBJECT]->(viewObject) RETURN usage

concept.description: Resolves entity-association ends to Entity Objects.
concept.cypher: MATCH (:Bc4jEntityAssociation)-[:HAS_END]->(end:Bc4jAssociationEnd) MATCH (entity:Bc4jEntity) WHERE entity.qualifiedName = end.ownerEntityFqn MERGE (end)-[:REFERENCES_ENTITY]->(entity) RETURN end

concept.description: Resolves ViewLinks to their referenced EntityAssociations.
concept.cypher: MATCH (viewLink:Bc4jViewLink) WHERE viewLink.entityAssociationFqn IS NOT NULL MATCH (association:Bc4jEntityAssociation) WHERE association.qualifiedName = viewLink.entityAssociationFqn MERGE (viewLink)-[:BASED_ON_ASSOCIATION]->(association) RETURN viewLink

concept.description: Resolves runtime configuration entries to ApplicationModules.
concept.cypher: MATCH (configuration:Bc4jApplicationModuleConfig) MATCH (applicationModule:Bc4jApplicationModule) WHERE applicationModule.qualifiedName = configuration.applicationName MERGE (configuration)-[:CONFIGURES]->(applicationModule) RETURN configuration

concept.description: Links BC4J project package registrations to their components.
concept.cypher: MATCH (:Bc4jProject)-[:DECLARES_PACKAGE]->(package:Bc4jPackage) MATCH (component) WHERE component.qualifiedName STARTS WITH package.qualifiedName + "." AND (component:Bc4jEntity OR component:Bc4jViewObject OR component:Bc4jEntityAssociation OR component:Bc4jViewLink OR component:Bc4jApplicationModule) MERGE (package)-[:CONTAINS_COMPONENT]->(component) RETURN package

concept.description: Links project-declared ApplicationModules to their definitions.
concept.cypher: MATCH (project:Bc4jProject) UNWIND project.applicationModuleNames AS applicationName MATCH (applicationModule:Bc4jApplicationModule) WHERE applicationModule.qualifiedName = applicationName MERGE (project)-[:DECLARES_APPLICATION_MODULE]->(applicationModule) RETURN applicationModule

concept.description: Resolves ViewObject attributes to their mapped EntityObject attributes.
concept.cypher: MATCH (viewObject:Bc4jViewObject)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]->(viewAttribute:Bc4jViewAttribute) WHERE viewAttribute.entityUsageName IS NOT NULL AND viewAttribute.entityAttributeName IS NOT NULL MATCH (viewObject)-[:HAS_ENTITY_USAGE]->(usage:Bc4jEntityUsage)-[:REFERENCES_ENTITY]->(entity:Bc4jEntity) WHERE usage.name = viewAttribute.entityUsageName MATCH (entity)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]->(entityAttribute:Bc4jEntityAttribute) WHERE entityAttribute.name = viewAttribute.entityAttributeName MERGE (viewAttribute)-[:MAPS_TO]->(entityAttribute) RETURN viewAttribute
